_notes: Curated value types for Divi 5 (5.13.1) option-group families and for module-specific leaves the dump does not type. Paths come from research/divi5-schema (the union model, research/divi5/schema.md §3); this file only types them. build_schema5.py keeps a family entry only when the union declares that path (or the entry says "add" with its evidence), so fragments may be supersets. Evidence per family is in its _notes. Sources: JS = the field configs in visual-builder/build/module.js (component, features, option constants); D4 = the Divi 4 field (research/divi-schema) reached through the runtime D4->D5 conversion map; corpus = values in tests/fixtures/divi5 (Divi's converter, Divi AI and VB output). Leaf defaults: bp true, states [value, hover, sticky] (module.json features default {responsive, hover, sticky} = true). When a value's grammar is unclear the leaf is typed text or object rather than given invented options.

_types.text: a string (plain text, CSS text, an id, a date, a CSS value Divi passes through verbatim)
_types.html: a string of HTML; innerContent rich text/code, stored JSON-escaped (\u003c...) in the block comment
_types.color: hex (#rgb/#rrggbb/#rrggbbaa), rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() (any case), transparent, or a $variable({"type":"color",...})$ global color reference
_types.length: a CSS length: number + unit (one of units when given), a bare 0, auto/none/inherit/initial, calc()/clamp()/min()/max()/var(), a $variable({"type":"content",...})$ number variable, or "" (unset)
_types.number: a number or a numeric string (unitless), or a $variable number reference
_types.enum: one of options (strings); with multiple: true, a list of options
_types.url: a URL string (absolute, relative, #anchor, mailto:, tel:) or a $variable dynamic-content reference
_types.image: an image URL string (src/url leaves); id/alt/titleText are sibling leaves, not part of this value
_types.spacing: an object with keys from top, right, bottom, left (lengths) and syncVertical, syncHorizontal (on/off)
_types.radius: an object with keys from topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft (lengths) and sync (on/off); Divi's converter may also write a single length string
_types.gradient: a list of gradient stops [{position: number|string, color: color}]
_types.object: a JSON object whose keys are not validated (opaque)
_types.font-family: a font family name string, or a $variable({"type":"content",...})$ global font reference
_types.font-weight: 100..900 as a string/number, normal/bold/lighter/bolder, a Divi global-font weight token ("<Font>_weight", written by Divi AI), or a $variable reference
_types.json: any JSON value (list, object or scalar); structure not validated

text-align.note: JS Zu() left/center/right/justify; D4 text orientation also writes justified

shadow-style.note: none or a Divi preset name (preset1..presetN); D4 presets_shadow/select_box_shadow, corpus none/preset1-6; number of presets not pinned

speed-curve.note: animation uses CSS names (JS Aa, D4); the transition group's JS options (Bv) are camelCase; both accepted

scroll-effect.note: {enable, viewport: {bottom, end, start, top}, offset: {start, mid, end}} (AdvancedOptionConversion::convertScroll); open: keys other than the declared enable are accepted untyped

font._notes: divi/font field configs (JS): range fields are lengths (units Hu = CSS length units); columnCount/weightFineTune use allowedUnits [""] (unitless); capitalization/style options from JS Ju subsets; lineStyle JS Qu; opticalSizing literal; writingMode JS td; textAlign JS Zu() plus D4 justify. headingLevel/textAlign are hover:false sticky:false.

capitalization.note: JS button-options {uppercase,capitalize,lowercase,smallCaps,allSmallCaps}; D4 all_caps converts through convertAllCaps; none = unset

hyphens.note: JS divi/toggle-like control; CSS hyphens value not pinned

style.note: list of styles; JS options {italic,underline,overline,strikethrough} (+ Ju capitalization keys, which the same Ju constant holds)

textWrap.note: JS button-options with a computed option list (y); CSS text-wrap keyword

list._notes: divi/font list sub-group (has_list / has_paragraph variants). D4 list type options are the CSS list-style-type keywords (ul: disc/circle/square/none; ol: 19 keywords): typed text because the union spans both.

text-shadow._notes: divi/text-shadow (JS ranges in em; D4 range em..vw; style presets_shadow)

gradient._notes: divi/common-css-gradient value object. type options: D4 background_color_gradient_type + JS; length: D4 wrote the unit select here, so the converter can store a bare unit (corpus "%") -> text.

type.note: D4 linear/circular/elliptical/conic; radial kept for native D5 content

directionRadial.note: D4 options center/top left/top/.../left; D5 may store other position keywords

length.note: D4 background_color_gradient_unit (a unit select) converts here; corpus has "100%" and "%"

bg-image-layer._notes: background image / text-effects image fill: D4 background_image_* fields; position goes through convertBackgroundPosition (D4 top_left -> D5 "center top" style keywords) -> text

position.note: CSS background-position keywords after convertBackgroundPosition (corpus center, center top)

text-effects._notes: divi/font textEffects (JS only, no D4 counterpart): fillType JS lv; strokePosition JS uv; strokeWidth range px/em/rem/vh/vw.

gradient.stops.add: the same divi/common-css-gradient control writes the stops list in text effects as in backgrounds

background._notes: divi/background (JS + D4 background_* via the conversion map). enable* flags are non-preset leaves (D4 background_enable_*). mask/pattern style option lists are D4's; transforms go through convertSvgTransform (value shape not pinned -> json). video.width/height are D4 text fields.
background.image.title: text

mask.style.note: a mask shape slug (D4 select-mask: layer-blob, arch, ..., wave; corpus diagonal, diagonal-bars, caret)

pattern.style.note: a pattern slug (D4 select-pattern: polka-dots, 3d-diamonds, ..., zig-zag)

border._notes: divi/border: radius = divi/border-radius (D4 border_radii via convertBorderRadii); styles.<side>.{width,style,color} from D4 border_{width,style,color}_<side>

box-shadow._notes: divi/box-shadow (D4 box_shadow_*; position JS Wl outer/inner)

sizing._notes: divi/sizing (JS). Width/height ranges are lengths (D4 width/max_width/height/min_height/max_height). Flex/grid leaves are D5-only: alignSelf/gridAlignSelf/gridJustifySelf option constants are spread from other objects in the bundle, so they are typed text (CSS keywords); grid line numbers accept auto/span -> text. flexType is a column class like 12_24.

aspectRatio.note: JS divi/aspect-ratio: a ratio like 16/9 or auto

spacing._notes: divi/spacing: margin/padding are spacing objects (D4 custom_margin/custom_padding via convertSpacing). Deeper keys (padding.top, ...) belong to the spacing value.

button-options._notes: divi/button's own leaves (D4 custom_button, button_icon*, button_alignment)

icon.settings.note: JS icon-picker hover:false preset html/style; D4 button_icon through convertButtonIcon

icon-group._notes: divi/icon group (color/size/useSize/show) plus the icon value itself: D4 font_icon converts into the same attr through convertFontIcon, so {unicode,type,weight} sit beside color/size (corpus testimonial/video/accordion)

unicode.add: convertFontIcon writes the icon object into X.decoration.icon (corpus)

type.add: convertFontIcon writes the icon object into X.decoration.icon (corpus)

weight.add: convertFontIcon writes the icon object into X.decoration.icon (corpus)

font._notes: divi/font (all 5 variants: has_heading_level/has_list/has_paragraph/has_border). The bare attr ("") also holds color/size/textAlign/headingLevel in some modules (accordion open/closed toggle).

font-body._notes: divi/font-body: body/link/ul/ol/quote sub-fonts + dropCap; quote.border = blockquote left border (D4 quote_border_*)

inline-font._notes: fonts used inside rich text (D4 inline_fonts through convertInlineFont): a list of family names

button._notes: divi/button. Divi's expander also lists the group's own sub-attrs under the button attr itself (X.decoration.button.decoration.background, ...font.font, .innerContent); they are kept as declared by the dump.

accent-color._notes: form accent color (checkbox/radio) - a single color

animation._notes: divi/animation (JS: all hover:false sticky:false; D4 animation_*; style/direction/repeat/speedCurve option constants JS Ca/Sa/wa/Aa = D4 lists). Durations/delays are ms lengths; intensities and startingOpacity are unitless/% numbers stored as strings.

attributes._notes: custom HTML attributes: a list of {id, name, value, targetElement} objects (corpus)

conditions._notes: display conditions (D4 display_conditions through convert_conditions): a list of condition objects

disabled-on._notes: D4 disabled_on through convertDisabledOnBreakpoint: an object keyed by breakpoint/disabledOn item (desktopAbove, tabletOnly, phone, ...) with on/off

filters._notes: divi/filters (JS ranges: blur px, hueRotate deg, others %; D4 filter_*). blendMode JS jc = D4 mix_blend_mode list.

fit._notes: divi/fit (JS: objectFit literal options, objectPosition divi/object-position)

interactions._notes: D5 interactions (triggers/effects list); structure not dumped

layout._notes: divi/layout (JS, D5-only; features hover:false sticky:false). display JS ly (converter writes block); flexDirection JS uy; grid options JS by/hy/vy/fy/gy. justifyContent/alignItems/alignContent/flexWrap build their options elsewhere -> text (CSS keywords). Grid templates/gaps are CSS text/lengths.

position._notes: divi/position (JS mode Mb default/relative/absolute/fixed; D4 positioning none/relative/absolute/fixed; origins are corner keywords like "top left" (corpus), D4 top_left)

scroll._notes: divi/scroll (D4 scroll_* motion fields through convertScroll): each effect value is {enable, viewport {bottom,end,start,top}, offset {start,mid,end}} (AdvancedOptionConversion.php convertScroll); *.enable toggles are declared, the rest of the effect object is open; motionTriggerStart D4 middle/top/bottom

sticky._notes: divi/sticky (JS hover:false sticky:false; limits JS Bh = D4; position JS Fh topBottom, D4 top_bottom)

transform._notes: divi/transform (D4 transform_* through convertTransform): rotate {x,y,z}, scale/skew/translate {x,y,linked}, origin {x,y}; values are lengths (deg, %, px) - typed object (opaque) per axis group

transition._notes: divi/transition (JS hover:false sticky:false; ms lengths; D4 hover_transition_*)

meta._notes: divi/meta (forceVisible toggle, tocListHeading toggle for table-of-contents)

dividers._notes: section dividers (D4 {top,bottom}_divider_*): style list D4 divider options; arrangement JS Ac above/below vs D4 above_content/below_content; flip D4 multiple_buttons through dividersFlip -> list

email-service._notes: divi/email-service (D4 provider list; account through convertEmailServiceAccount = "<name>|<list id>" strings, corpus)

provider.note: D4 list: activecampaign, aweber, ..., mailchimp, ..., sendinblue; D5 may add providers

gutter._notes: divi/gutter (row gutters; D4 use_custom_gutter/gutter_width/make_equal). width is the gutter number 1..4 (JS range min 1 max 4 unitless); alignColumns JS button-options (flex-start/center/...) -> text

html._notes: divi/html (elementType select of HTML tag names, htmlBefore/After code)

elementType.note: an HTML tag name from Divi's VALID_HTML_ELEMENT_TYPES

link._notes: divi/link (D4 link_option_url / link_option_url_new_window off|on; lightbox toggle)

loop._notes: divi/loop query builder (JS, D5-only): selects with dynamic options (post types, taxonomies) -> text; tag inputs / meta query -> json

text._notes: divi/text: text.color = light/dark text scheme (D4 background_layout), orientation = alignment (D4 text_orientation); textShadow = divi/text-shadow

css.note: custom CSS declarations for a CSS slot (D4 custom_css_*)

on.note: block-level attr from Conversion::getAttrMap; value shape not documented

components._notes: module.json field component -> leaf type for module-specific (non-group) leaves. Options come from props.options, units from props.allowedUnits, bp/states from features.

d4_types._notes: Divi 4 field type -> leaf type, used through the conversion map when module.json has no field item. D4 options are kept only when the D4 attr has no valueExpansionFunction (values copied verbatim).

*._notes: Fallback types for module-specific leaves with no module.json field item and no typed D4 field (applied last; fnmatch patterns on the attrName).

content.note: D4 shortcode content converted to the content attr

backgroundHorizontalOffset?.note: legacy D4 row per-column background_*_N setting

module.advanced.type.note: structural: column width (1_2, 4_4, ...), section type (""/regular, fullwidth, specialty), group type; conversion map only

children.advanced.*.note: parent-level defaults for child elements; shape not dumped

rel.note: link rel values (list); options not dumped

lottie._notes: Divi 5-only Lottie module; option lists not dumped -> text

icon._notes: divi/icon: icon.innerContent holds the icon object and the link fields in one value

icon.innerContent.note: module.json declares a divi/icon-picker for the whole attr; the D4 link fields are sub-leaves of the same value

unicode.add: font_icon converts into this attr through convertFontIcon, merging {unicode,type,weight} into the value beside url/target/title (corpus divi/icon)

icon-list-item._notes: icon.innerContent holds the icon object and the title in one value (same shape as divi/icon)

unicode.add: font_icon converts into this attr through convertFontIcon, merging {unicode,type,weight} into the value beside url/target/title (corpus divi/icon)

map._notes: map center: Divi stores lat/lng/zoom as JSON numbers (corpus), D4 had text fields

fullwidth-map._notes: map center: Divi stores lat/lng/zoom as JSON numbers (corpus), D4 had text fields

attr_aliases._notes: Divi's converter mirrors the D4 form-field settings of field.advanced.* onto the checkbox and radio elements (corpus: forms-heldout contact-form checkbox.advanced.focus.font.font, forms-tuned-signup checkbox/radio.advanced.nameFullwidth); the dump only declares the field.* copy. contact-field and signup-custom-field have the same field/checkbox/radio elements and are mirrored by analogy.
